sentences.text:
Applicant :- Rahimullah And Another Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Bind,Raj Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
List revised.
Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar Bind, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri B.B. Upadhyay, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Rahimullah and Mona Begum with the prayer to quash the entire proceeding including the charge sheet dated 16.8.2021 as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 1.1.2022 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Prayagraj in Case No. Nil of 2022 (State vs. Azad@Kallu and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 329 of 2021, under Section 498A I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali,
District Prayagraj, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Prayagraj and with the further prayer to stay the further proceedings of aforesaid case during pendency of the present Rahimullah And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113240486/
1 application.
Learned counsel for the applicants states that the present application be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file a better application.
